raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: Misapplied the truth/lie logic. If all 100 residents are vampires, the statement “At least one of us is a human” is false, so vampires can all utter it consistently. The Orchestrator incorrectly treated this case as a contradiction and concluded 99 vampires and 1 human. In fact, if even one human existed, the statement would be true and vampires could not all say it. The only configuration consistent with everyone giving that response and the presence of a vampire is 100 vampires.
